title: Lost or Stolen Phone? How to Block It on Sanchar Saathi (CEIR) and Help Police Trace It
seoTitle: How to Block a Lost Phone on CEIR: Sanchar Saathi Steps
seoDescription: Block a lost or stolen phone on CEIR: police complaint, duplicate SIM, OTP and request ID, what tracing really means, and how to unblock it after recovery.
excerpt: The complete CEIR sequence from DoT's own manual: documents, the block form, status checks, unblocking with your request ID, IMEI checks for used phones, and a clear table of what the system can and cannot do.
